title: Journal Bearing
model_title: Hydrodynamic Plain Journal Bearing (Split Babbitt-Lined Shell)

introduction.definition: A hydrodynamic journal bearing supports a rotating shaft on an oil film. The shaft runs slightly off-centre in a babbitt-lined bore; its rotation drags oil into the narrowing gap and generates pressure that lifts the shaft. Oil enters through holes and axial grooves at the split line and leaves at the ends, carrying heat away.
applications: Turbines, compressors, large motors and generators
key_points: Film pressure from rotation (no pump needed for load)
introduction.summary: A hydrodynamic journal bearing supports a rotating shaft on a pressurised oil film generated by the shaft's own rotation in a slightly larger, babbitt-lined bore.

pressure.title: Hydrodynamic pressure lifts the journal
pressure.description: When the shaft turns it drags oil into the narrowing gap on one side of the eccentric journal. The wedge builds pressure (bars) that floats the shaft on an oil film; the shaft settles at an eccentricity and attitude angle that balance the load. Minimum film thickness is typically ≈ 10–50 µm; the bearing clearance is ≈ 1–2 µm per mm of diameter. At start-up and shut-down there is little film, so most babbitt wear happens then (jacking oil is used on large machines).

video_tutorials.title: Journal Bearing — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Journal Bearing.
A hydrodynamic journal bearing supports a rotating shaft on an oil film.
The shaft runs slightly off-centre in a babbitt-lined bore; its rotation drags oil into the narrowing gap and generates pressure that lifts the shaft.
Oil enters through holes and axial grooves at the split line and leaves at the ends, carrying heat away.
Typical applications include turbines, compressors, large motors and generators; engines (crankshaft bearings) and large pumps.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Journal (shaft) — runs eccentric, clearance exaggerated for teaching, Bearing Pedestal & Cap (bolted at the horizontal split).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Journal Bearing.
Trend bearing temperature and shaft vibration.
Check clearance (lead/plastigage) and oil.
Re-babbitt / replace shells.
Watch for wiping: temperature spike. Common cause: oil starvation, overload.
Watch for oil whirl: sub-synchronous vibration ≈ 0.42–0.48×. Common cause: light load, high speed.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
